note: A steward-held [[errata.column]] takes its type only from its curated data_type (#1562): the global build reads no steward storage. Without one the state stays untyped with a located unknown_data_type error, the interim outcome for a worklisted column not yet curated. Expected literals: c-stew null with that issue, its is_identifier 1 and is_sensitive 0; c-cur integer with no issue. Each entry names versions = ["2020"] while the register also delivers 2018 and 2022 (EDITION, var 99), so each forms exactly one 2020 state (valid_to 2020-12-31): test_column_declaration_preserves_only_supplied_flags_and_periods[FIX-versions1] binds its one addition to the 2020 edition beside a later delivered edition that gains none. The third entry declares BLK for 2020, and the source documents the column by name only as Blk (var 31) in 2022, another spelling in another edition; the entry mints its own c-documented variable with one 2020 state and v31 keeps its 2022 state (#1621). The fourth entry declares NOW for 2020 and 2022, and the source documents NOW (var 26) in 2018 and 2020; the named 2020 overlaps a documenting edition, so it is refused as column_now_documented in the '<entry locator>: <blockers>' format the compile reports, and forms no c-now state. The fifth entry declares V1 for 2020; the source documents V1 (var 5) only in 2022, but an [[errata.occurrence_period]] entry moves that row to 2020, so the original scope no longer shows the periods disjoint and the entry is refused as column_now_documented too, forming no c-moved state. A V2 [[errata.delivered]] entry (2018) is compiled before it and must not change which register the period correction is matched against. The sixth entry declares ZED for 2020; the source documents no ZED, but an [[errata.field]] column_name correction renames v29's 2020 OTHERW row to ZED, so that literal is documented there and the entry is refused as column_now_documented, forming no c-renamed state.
fails_if: `scb_errata.convert_column_entry` types a steward-held column from anything but its curated `data_type`, stops reporting an untyped one as unknown_data_type, drops a curated `is_identifier`, adds a declared column to editions its `versions` do not name, stops refusing a column the source documents in an edition the entry names (`column_now_documented`), or again refuses one documented, under another spelling, only in editions the entry does not name, compares a documented row's original period when an occurrence_period correction moves it (including after an errata.delivered entry of the same register), or misses a literal an errata.field column_name correction introduces
